item.title: Smart Controls on Display at the AHR Expo
item.description: New residential and light commercial controls at the AHR Expo highlighted thermostats and solutions that help contractors install faster and service systems more efficiently.

item.title: Hammer-Free Drive Cleat Installation in Light Commercial Ductwork
item.description: A patented system enables safer, more precise drive cleat installation in ductwork without the need for hammering, reducing fatigue and improving alignment in light commercial HVAC projects.

item.title: Residential Cooling Systems Take Center Stage at AHR Expo
item.description: AHR Expo exhibitors introduced residential cooling technologies aimed at improving efficiency, expanding climate performance, and simplifying installs for contractors.

item.title: AI and Automation Take Center Stage at AHR 2026
item.description: From AI-powered voice agents and conversational assistants to cloud platforms and digital sales tools, this year’s software innovations focused on helping contractors save time, improve customer communication, and make faster, more informed decisions in the field.

item.title: HARDI Warns of Refrigerant Supply Disruptions in New York
item.description: New York’s refrigerant rules may cause supply shortages, raising costs for consumers and businesses, as industry groups push for regulatory alignment with federal standards to avoid disruptions.

item.title: Carrier, Tesla Team Up To Improve Grid Efficiency
item.description: The U.S. grid operates at just 53% of capacity on average. Manufacturers are teaming up to unlock the rest of its potential.

item.title: Johnson Controls named to USA 25 Most Sustainable Companies List
item.description: The USA 25 Most Sustainable Companies are ranked by portions of their revenue earned from sustainable business. Of nearly 1,500 U.S. companies evaluated, only 25 were selected for generating a significant share of revenue from sustainable business activities.

item.title: What an HVACR Contractor Wants, What a Contractor Needs (From Distributors)
item.description: A new industry survey sheds light on what HVAC contractors are expecting from their distributors.

item.title: New Tools and Test Instruments Built for Speed, Safety, and Tough Jobsite Conditions
item.description: Tool and test instrument manufacturers at the 2026 AHR Expo focused on innovations that make technicians faster, safer, and more efficient in the field.

item.title: Smarter, High-Efficiency Water Heaters From the AHR Show Floor
item.description: Water heater innovation was on full display at the 2026 AHR Expo, with manufacturers introducing new commercial and residential models designed to balance high efficiency, smarter connectivity, and easier installation.
